verdict.rationale: Pipedream MCP issues per-user credentials via external-user-id, keeps them encrypted at rest and proxied so the agent/model never sees raw tokens, and lets users revoke access at any time — a de facto least-privilege model per connected account/app. However there's no documented mechanism for an admin to define custom scopes or restrict which specific actions/tools an agent can use beyond the app-level tool boundary. missing for 10: explicit scope/permission configuration UI, independent verification of revocation behavior.
